about.title: The coach behind N-Force
about.lead: I am Nick Bergman, performance coach at ice hockey club Tilburg Trappers. I laid my foundation at the Fontys School of Sport Studies, specialising in strength & conditioning and sports medical training.
about.p1: As an S&C specialist I build a resilient, powerful and explosive body, with programmes that match the demands of the sport. My sports medical background also lets me bridge injury treatment and return to sport: by focusing on prevention and a carefully built return to play, athletes stay fit in the long run.
about.p2: In the daily practice of an elite sport environment there is no room for assumptions. What I programme I can justify, and what we programme we measure. I bring that way of working to every athlete and every club I work with.

pillar1.title: Strength & Conditioning
pillar1.text: As a specialist in Strength & Conditioning I focus on developing a resilient, powerful and explosive body. I design training programmes that fit the specific demands of the athlete or the sport seamlessly, with the aim of maximising total performance.

pillar2.title: Sports medical training & return to play
pillar2.text: My background as a sports medical trainer allows me to bridge the gap between injury treatment and returning to the field. By emphasising injury prevention and carefully built return to play training, athletes not only come back stronger, they also stay fit in the long term.

about.p3: In the demanding elite-sport environment at Tilburg Trappers I combine theory with daily practice. I like to use that top-level experience, drive and expertise to help you get the absolute maximum out of yourself.

faq.title: What athletes and clubs usually ask
faq.q1: Do you work with youth teams as well?
faq.a1: Yes. With youth athletes the emphasis is on movement quality, technique and a calm build-up of load: appropriate to age and development. Heavy loading is not a goal in itself; the goal is for players to become robust, coordinated and able to handle load. Alignment with coaches and parents is part of that.
faq.a2: Online coaching costs €49, €125 or €249 per month, depending on how much guidance you want, the differences are listed under Pricing. For teams and clubs it is bespoke: group size, phase of the season and the number of testing sessions determine the price, and you receive a fixed proposal after an intro call.
faq.q3: Do I need a gym for online coaching?
faq.a3: Not necessarily. The programme is built around the facilities you have: a commercial gym, your club's weight room or a limited home set-up. That said: the less equipment there is, the sooner we run into a ceiling on heavy strength goals. During the intake we look at what is realistically possible.
faq.q4: Will you come to our club?
faq.a4: Yes, for teams and clubs I work on site. My reach is primarily North Brabant; other provinces are possible by arrangement. We agree fixed days and times within your training week. Is your club further away? Get in touch, then we will see whether travel time and frequency can be organised.
faq.q5: How do you handle injuries and work with physiotherapists?
faq.a5: I do not treat injuries, that is the domain of the physiotherapist or doctor. What I do is adapt the training programme to what is possible, and agree with the treating practitioner how the build-up back to full load should look. If complaints are unclear I refer on and adjust the load until there is clarity.
faq.q6: How long am I tied to a package?
faq.a6: The minimum term is twelve weeks. That is not a sales trick: anything shorter than a twelve-week block makes it impossible to honestly measure whether it worked. After that it continues monthly and you can cancel each month. If you get injured or your season turns out differently, we pause in consultation. I will not be difficult about that.
faq.q7: How quickly will I notice results?
faq.a7: In the first weeks you mainly notice better execution and recovery. Measurable improvement in strength and explosiveness usually shows at the retest after twelve weeks. What exactly you gain depends on your starting point, your training age and how consistently you train, which is why I promise no numbers in advance, but measure them afterwards.

legal.meta_description: Privacy statement of N-Force Performance (Nick Bergman), strength and conditioning specialist: which personal data and training and health data are processed, on what legal basis, how long they are kept and what rights you have.
legal.title: Privacy statement
legal.intro: N-Force Performance, run by Nick Bergman (hereafter: “I”), processes personal data of clients, athletes and club contacts. For strength and conditioning support this also involves data about health and training. In this statement you can read which data I process, why, on what legal basis, how long I keep it and what rights you have. This statement follows the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
legal.s1_li2: Area of work: North Brabant · nationwide · online (no public business location)
legal.s1_fg: I have not appointed a data protection officer (DPO); that is not mandatory for a business of this size.
legal.s2_contact2: Club, team or organisation name and the contact person's role
legal.s2_contact3: Invoicing and payment details, address details
legal.s2_contact4: Correspondence (email, messages in the coaching app)
legal.s2_training1: Test results: sprint, jump and strength tests
legal.s2_training2: Training logs: exercises, weights, sets, repetitions, times
legal.s2_training3: Subjective feedback: perceived exertion, recovery, sleep, muscle soreness
legal.s2_training4: Video recordings of exercises that you submit yourself for technique feedback
legal.s2_training5: Sporting background, match calendar, training availability
legal.s2_h_health: Health data (special categories of personal data)
legal.s2_health1: Age, height, weight and comparable body characteristics
legal.s2_health2: Injury history, current complaints and limitations
legal.s2_health3: Load tolerance advice or treatment information that you, your physiotherapist or your doctor shares with me
legal.s2_health_note: Health data are special categories of personal data. I process them only on the basis of your explicit consent, only in so far as necessary to programme safely and responsibly, and no longer than necessary. I am not a healthcare provider and I do not make diagnoses.
legal.s2_minors: For athletes under 16 I process data solely with the consent of a parent or legal guardian. Reports about youth players are only shared with the people agreed upon (for example parents and technical staff).
legal.s2_site: This website places no tracking or analytics cookies and uses no analytics software. The contact form is processed by Formcarry, a service provider with servers in Frankfurt, Germany. Formcarry forwards your message to my mailbox and also stores it in a secured environment that only I can access; I delete messages there once they have been handled. I receive your name, email address, chosen topic and your message. If sending fails, your own email programme opens as a fallback. Your language choice is stored in one functional cookie in your own browser. That cookie contains only the language code, is not shared with me or third parties, and is necessary for this function. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts and Fontshare; your IP address may be processed by those parties. The hosting provider may keep technical log files (such as IP address and requested page) for security and availability.
legal.h3: 3. Why I process this data, and on what legal basis
legal.table_label: Overview of purposes, data and legal bases: scrollable horizontally
legal.r1c1: Performing the coaching or support agreement: setting up and adjusting the programme, testing and reporting
legal.r1c2: Contact details, training and performance data
legal.r2c1: Programming safely around injuries, complaints and load tolerance
legal.r3c1: Consultation and alignment with coaches, technical staff, physiotherapist or doctor
legal.r4c1: Responding to questions and requests by email or form
legal.r4c2: Contact details, the content of your message
legal.r4c3: Legitimate interest or preparation of a contract (Art. 6(1)(f) / (b))
legal.r6c1: Use of images or results for promotion
legal.r6c3: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): always requested separately and revocable
legal.s3_note: I do not use automated decision-making or profiling with legal consequences. I make training decisions myself, together with you.
legal.s4_li1: Financial administration and invoices: 7 years, based on the statutory tax retention obligation.
legal.s4_li2: Training and test data: for the duration of our work together and 2 years thereafter, so your history is available if you return. After that I delete it or make it anonymous.
legal.s4_li3: Health data: until no later than 1 year after the end of our work together, unless you ask for deletion sooner.
legal.s4_li4: Video recordings for technique feedback: 6 months, then deleted.
legal.s4_li5: Enquiries that do not lead to a collaboration: a maximum of 12 months.
legal.s5_intro: I do not sell your data and share it only where necessary:
legal.s5_li1: Coaches, technical staff, physiotherapist or doctor: only with your consent and only what is relevant.
legal.s5_li2: Parents or legal guardians of underage athletes.
legal.s5_li3: Service providers (processors) that I use to run the business: Everfit (coaching app), e-Boekhouden.nl (bookkeeping and invoicing), TransIP (domain and business email), Railway (hosting of this website), Formcarry (contact form processing, Frankfurt). I conclude data processing agreements with these parties.
legal.s5_li4: Bookkeeper or accountant and, where legally required, the Dutch Tax Administration or other authorities.
legal.s5_transfer: Some suppliers may process data outside the European Economic Area. In that case I ensure a valid transfer mechanism, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
legal.s6: I take appropriate technical and organisational measures: devices with disk encryption and a passcode, strong and unique passwords with two-factor authentication, restricted access to files, and the use of secure connections (HTTPS) for the website and the coaching app. I keep health data separate from general administration. In the event of a data breach with a risk to data subjects, I report it to the Dutch Data Protection Authority within 72 hours and inform you where required.
legal.s7_intro: Under the GDPR you have the following rights:
legal.s7_li1: Access to the data I process about you.
legal.s7_li3: Erasure (the “right to be forgotten”), unless I am legally required to keep the data.
legal.s7_li5: Objection to processing based on legitimate interest.
legal.s7_li6: Data portability: receiving your data in a common file format or having it transferred.
legal.s7_li7: Withdrawing consent, at any time. Withdrawal applies going forward; processing that took place before it remains lawful. Please note: without consent for health data I cannot responsibly continue the coaching.
legal.s7_request: Send your request to nick@nforce-performance.nl. I respond within one month. To prevent misuse I may ask you to substantiate your identity; never send a full copy of your ID document, but cover the photo and personal identification number.
legal.s8: If you are not satisfied with how I handle your data, please let me know first, then we can look for a solution together. You also always have the right to file a complaint with the supervisory authority, the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
legal.s9: I may amend this privacy statement, for example if my services or the software I use change. The current version is always on this page, with the date of the last change at the top.
legal.disclaimer: This privacy statement is a carefully prepared basis, but not legal advice. The postal address above still needs to be filled in; have the text reviewed by a lawyer if in doubt.

p_teams.meta_description: Strength and conditioning for sports teams and clubs in Noord-Brabant: season periodisation, testing moments throughout the season and alignment with technical staff and physiotherapy.
p_teams.title: Strength that fits the season
p_teams.lead: Most teams train strength on top of everything else instead of inside it. The result is heavy legs on match days and a squad that fades in the second half of the season. I build a programme that moves with your match calendar instead of against it.
p_teams.who_x: For clubs and teams that want more than a standard schedule, and that want to be able to explain why training looks the way it does.
p_teams.who1: Teams in ice sports, indoor sports and field sports
p_teams.who2: Youth academies wanting a continuous development line
p_teams.who3: Clubs without their own strength and conditioning specialist
p_teams.who4: Staff who want strength work and rehab to line up better
p_teams.get_x: Not a loose training schedule, but a season structure with measurement moments and reporting you can actually use.
p_teams.get1: Season periodisation around your match calendar
p_teams.get2: Baseline testing of the full squad and retests per block
p_teams.get3: A programme per block, adjusted to load and match density
p_teams.get4: Reporting per player plus an overview for the staff
p_teams.get5: Alignment with coaches, physiotherapist and medical staff
p_teams.get6: On-site guidance, or instruction of your own staff
p_teams.cta_x: Curious how this plays out for your squad? That takes a twenty-minute conversation.
p_teams.steps_t: From intro call to season report
p_teams.step1_x: We discuss your squad, calendar, facilities and where the staff feels it goes wrong. That produces a proposal with a concrete setup and price.
p_teams.step2_x: A testing day with sprint, jump and strength tests that suit your sport. Every player gets a baseline, the team gets a profile.
p_teams.step3_x: Blocks of four to six weeks with a clear progression in load, matched to match density and the sessions on the pitch or the ice.
p_teams.step4_x: At the end of each block we measure again with the same protocols. What worked continues, what lagged behind gets adjusted.
p_teams.practical: Practical: on-site work in Noord-Brabant, elsewhere by arrangement. Standalone testing days from €750. Season programmes receive a fixed proposal after the intro call, excluding VAT.
p_teams.q1: Do you work with youth teams too?
p_teams.a1: Yes, and different rules apply there. With youth the emphasis is on movement quality, load tolerance and a progression that suits biological age, not maximum strength. Reports on underage players are shared only with the people agreed in advance, with parental consent.
p_teams.q2: Do we need our own equipment?
p_teams.a2: Not necessarily. I work with what is there and build the programme around your facilities. If something essential is missing I will say so honestly, and we look for an alternative or a solution within budget.
p_teams.a3: They are not left out. I align with your physiotherapist so rehab and strength training form one line, and build the return to match load step by step rather than all at once.
p_teams.cta2_x: Another question about your club? Just ask, even if you are not ready to commit to anything.

p_online.who_x: For athletes who train seriously and want to know whether they are progressing rather than hoping so.
p_online.who1: Individual athletes in ice sports, indoor sports and field sports
p_online.who2: Athletes building purposefully alongside team training
p_online.who3: Athletes abroad: coaching runs in Dutch, English or German
p_online.who4: Athletes returning from injury who want to build back properly
p_online.get_x: A programme that moves every four weeks, not a schedule you receive in January and are still doing in June.
p_online.get1: A bespoke programme in the app, with video for every exercise
p_online.get2: Weekly check-in on load, recovery and sleep
p_online.get4: Test protocols you can run yourself, with a retest after twelve weeks
p_online.get6: Alignment with your coach or physiotherapist where that helps
p_online.cta_x: Not sure which package fits? We work that out in the intro call, including if the answer is that you do not need me yet.
p_online.step1_x: Twenty minutes, online or by phone. You tell me where you want to go, I tell you honestly whether I am the right person for it.
p_online.step2_x: Goals, match calendar, injury history, available time and facilities. Then you run a test battery suited to your sport, under instruction.
p_online.step3_x: Your programme runs in blocks. A check-in every week, a revision every four weeks based on how it went.
p_online.step4_x: Same protocols, same conditions. That shows you in black and white what has changed and where the next gain sits.
p_online.practical: Practical: €49, €125 or €249 per month, including VAT. Minimum term of twelve weeks, cancellable monthly thereafter. The differences are listed under Pricing on the homepage.
p_online.a1: For most programmes yes, because external load is simply the tool. If you only have limited space or home equipment, say so in the intro call, then we look at whether I can coach you responsibly or whether you are better off with something else.
p_online.a2: Then we adjust the programme instead of you grinding to a halt. For an injury that needs treatment I work together with your physiotherapist; I do not diagnose and I do not take over their work.
p_online.a3: Yes, by arrangement. Holidays, exams, a season that turns out differently: I will not be difficult about that. After the first twelve weeks you can also cancel monthly.
p_online.cta2_x: Still unsure whether online coaching suits you? Just ask.

p_testing.meta_description: Performance testing for teams and individual athletes: sprint, jump and strength tests, reporting per athlete and per team, and concrete training advice drawn from the data.
p_testing.title: Knowing where you stand, in numbers
p_testing.lead: Without a baseline every training choice is an assumption. A testing day gives you an objective picture of your squad or yourself within half a day, and a report that leads to concrete training decisions.
p_testing.who_x: For teams and athletes who want to steer on data, and for staff who want to be able to justify their choices.
p_testing.who1: Clubs wanting a baseline at the start of the season
p_testing.who2: Teams wanting to know whether a block worked
p_testing.who3: Individual athletes mapping their strengths and weaknesses
p_testing.who4: Practices wanting an objective measure on return to sport
p_testing.get_x: A test battery suited to your sport. No testing for the sake of testing: only measurements that lead to a training decision.
p_testing.get1: Sprint over 10 and 30 metres with timing gates
p_testing.get2: Jump performance: countermovement jump and squat jump
p_testing.get3: Strength and strength endurance, with an estimate of maximal strength
p_testing.get5: Movement quality in the main compound lifts
p_testing.get6: Report per athlete plus a team overview with comparison
p_testing.cta_x: Want to know where you stand before starting a programme? That is a fine place to begin.
p_testing.step1_x: We determine which tests make sense for your sport and goal, and what is practically needed in space, time and equipment.
p_testing.step2_x: On site, in a fixed order with a standard warm-up so results are comparable. A squad of twenty players usually fits in half a day.
p_testing.step3_x: Within a week you receive a report: per athlete the results with context, and for teams an overview showing quickly where attention should go.
p_testing.step4_x: We walk through the outcomes and translate them into training choices, including if you continue on your own afterwards.
p_testing.practical: Practical: testing days from €750, depending on group size, travel distance and the scope of the reporting. Testing can stand alone or be a fixed part of a season programme.
p_testing.q1: How many athletes fit into one day?
p_testing.a1: A squad of around twenty players fits into half a day, provided there is enough space to rotate in small groups. Larger groups are spread across several sessions, so measurement quality does not suffer from rushing.
p_testing.a2: Test results are personal data, and where health information is involved they are special category data. I share them only with the people agreed in advance, for minors with parental consent, and do not use them for promotion without separate consent.
p_testing.a3: No, but without a retest you do not know whether it worked. The real value of testing sits in the comparison, not in the first result.
p_testing.cta2_x: Want to discuss what is worth measuring in your situation?

p_results.meta_description: Measurable results and experiences from athletes, staff and physiotherapists working with N-Force Performance. Figures anonymised, quotes with consent.
p_results.title: What it delivers
p_results.lead: No promises: measurements and experiences from the people I work with. Figures appear here anonymised, quotes only with the consent of the person involved.
p_results.measured_x: Every value below comes from the same test protocols at the baseline and the retest, under comparable conditions.
p_results.empty_metrics: The first programmes are under way. As soon as retests are completed, the figures will appear here: anonymised and with consent.
p_results.empty_reviews: I am working with my first clients. Experiences from players, staff and physiotherapists will appear here once they are in.
p_results.cases_x: A full programme from starting point to retest, so you can see what realistically changes in twelve weeks.
p_results.empty_cases: The first worked-out programme will appear here after the first round of retests.
p_results.share_x: Then I would like to hear what it brought you, including if it fell short. Three questions help turn it into something useful:
p_results.share1: What were you running into before we started?
p_results.share3: What do you notice now: on the pitch, in your recovery or in the numbers?

p_results.honest_t: Why there is little here yet
p_results.honest_x: N-Force Performance has just started. I would rather put nothing here than something I cannot back up: no bought reviews, no figures without a retest, no names without consent. What appears here later is genuinely measured and genuinely said.
p_results.honest_x2: In the meantime you can judge me on where I work, what I have learned and how I go about things, and on the conversation itself.
